environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a private subnet with an Application Load Balancer (internet-facing). The ALB has a default HTTPS listener forwarding to the target group. The RDS PostgreSQL instance uses the 'app' role with full DML/DDL privileges on the 'inventory' database. No WAF is attached to the ALB. The ECS task role has AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB and inbound 8080 from the ALB SG on the ECS tasks.

config.network: public ALB -> private ECS -> private RDS
